extras.textures: PBR 2048px: base color, roughness, metallic, normal (baked)
extras.real_size: steam locomotive with tender on a short track, approx. 11 x 2.8 x 4.3 m (L x W x H incl. track), locomotive 6.6 m, driving wheel diameter 1.2 m, standard gauge 1435 mm
extras.notes: front faces -Y; 12 wheels are separate objects with origin on the axle (rotate around local X to roll); coupling rods (steam-train_coupling_rod_l/_r) are separate objects with origin on the middle crank pin: keep their orientation and move the origin on a circle of radius 0.30 m around the middle driving axle in step with the wheel rotation (left side leads the right side by 90 deg); the track (steam-train_track) is a separate object, rail top at 0.30 m; opaque tinted windows, no interior; neutral star emblem, no brand, no text

origin.detail: Built procedurally with Blender scripts. The scripts were written with the help of an AI coding assistant. No generative AI model produced the geometry or textures directly.
